Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 137. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 10 Ki per +1 bonus
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 reaction when you are forced to
make a Constitution, Dexterity, or Strength saving
throw
Range: Self
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Omni
Form a barrier of ki around you granting you as +1
bonus to the triggering saving throw. You may not
increase this bonus beyond +3 in this way.
